    // --- GLOBAL PUSH NOTIFICATION SYSTEM ---
    function setupGlobalNotifications() {
        // যদি অ্যাপটি মোবাইলে রান না হয় বা প্লাগিন না থাকে, তবে রিটার্ন করবে
        if (!window.cordova || !cordova.plugins || !cordova.plugins.notification) return;

        // ইউজারের সব বন্ধুদের চ্যাট লিস্টে নজর রাখা হচ্ছে
        onValue(ref(db, 'friends/' + currentUser.uid), snap => {
            const friends = snap.val() || {};
            
            for(const fid of Object.keys(friends)) {
                const chatId = [currentUser.uid, fid].sort().join("_");
                
                // শুধুমাত্র একেবারে শেষের (নতুন) মেসেজটি আসার জন্য অপেক্ষা করবে
                const lastMsgQuery = query(ref(db, 'messages/' + chatId), limitToLast(1));
                
                onChildAdded(lastMsgQuery, async (childSnap) => {
                    const msg = childSnap.val();
                    
                    // মেসেজটি কি গত ৫ সেকেন্ডের মধ্যে এসেছে? (যাতে পুরোনো মেসেজে নোটিফিকেশন না বাজে)
                    const now = Date.now();
                    const msgTime = msg.timestamp || 0;
                    const isRecent = (now - msgTime) < 5000;

                    // চ্যাট বক্স কি খোলা আছে? খোলা থাকলে নোটিফিকেশন দেওয়ার দরকার নেই
                    const isChatOpen = (currentChat && getChatId(currentChat) === chatId && !document.hidden);

                    if (msg.sender !== currentUser.uid && isRecent && !isChatOpen) {
                        const sender = await fetchUser(msg.sender);
                        const senderName = sender ? sender.name : "NexusChat User";
                        let bodyText = msg.type === 'text' ? msg.text : `Sent a ${msg.type}`;

                        // 🚨 ম্যাজিক: মোবাইলের লোকাল পুশ নোটিফিকেশন পাঠানো হচ্ছে
                        cordova.plugins.notification.local.schedule({
                            id: new Date().getTime(),
                            title: senderName,
                            text: bodyText,
                            foreground: true, // অ্যাপ ওপেন থাকলেও নোটিফিকেশন আসবে
                            smallIcon: 'res://icon',
                            color: '#00f2fe'
                        });
                        
                        // নোটিফিকেশনে ক্লিক করলে সরাসরি অ্যাপে চলে আসবে
                        cordova.plugins.notification.local.on('click', function (notification) {
                            if(sender) openChat({...sender, type: 'user'});
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

            cachedGroups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nexus_cache_groups') || '{}');

            cachedGroupInfo = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nexus_cache_group_info') || '{}');

    async function fetchUser(uid) {
        if(!cachedUsers[uid]) {
            const snap = await get(ref(db, 'users/' + uid));
            if(snap.exists()) {
                cachedUsers[uid] = snap.val();
                saveLocalCache();
            }
        }
        return cachedUsers[uid];
    }

    async function fetchGroup(gid) {
        if(!cachedGroupInfo[gid]) {
            const snap = await get(ref(db, 'groups/' + gid));
            if(snap.exists()) {
                cachedGroupInfo[gid] = snap.val();
                saveLocalCache();
            }
        }
        return cachedGroupInfo[gid];
    }

    function getChatId(partner) {

        return [currentUser.uid, partner.uid].sort().join("_");

        dom('chat-header-pic').src = partner.profilePic;
        dom('chat-header-status').innerText = ""; 

        const isPending = (partner.type === 'pending');
        
        if(partner.type === 'user' && !isPending) {
            dom('chat-actions').classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            dom('chat-actions').classList.add('hidden');

            dom('pending-invite-bar').classList.add('hidden');

        if (partner.type === 'user') {
            onValue(ref(db, 'users/' + partner.uid + '/status'), snap => {

                const stText = dom('chat-header-status');
                if (s === 'online') {
                    stText.innerText = "Online";
                    stText.className = "status-text online";
                } else if (typeof s === 'number') {
                    const date = new Date(s);
                    stText.innerText = "Last seen " + date.toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'});
                    stText.className = "status-text";
                } else {
                    stText.innerText = "";
                }
            });
        } else if (partner.type === 'global') {
            dom('chat-header-status').innerText = "Public Room";
            dom('chat-header-status').className = "status-text online";
        }

        const chatId = getChatId(partner);
        markMessagesAsRead(chatId);

        onValue(ref(db, `typing/${chatId}`), snap => {
             const typers = snap.val();
             let isTyping = false;

    async function startRecord(e) {
        if(dom('msg-input').value.trim().length > 0) return; 
        e.preventDefault();
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
            audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
            microphone = audioContext.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
            microphone.connect(analyser);
            analyser.fftSize = 256;
            
            dom('msg-input').classList.add('hidden');
            dom('rec-visualizer').classList.remove('hidden');
            visualizeAudio(); 

            mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            audioChunks = [];
            mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = e => audioChunks.push(e.data);
            mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
                dom('msg-input').classList.remove('hidden');
                dom('rec-visualizer').classList.add('hidden');
                cancelAnimationFrame(visualizerInterval);
                audioContext.close();

                const blob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: 'audio/webm' });
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
                reader.onloadend = () => sendMessage(reader.result, 'audio');
                stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
            };
            mediaRecorder.start();
            micBtn.classList.add('recording');
        } catch(err) { console.log("Mic Error", err); }
    }

    function stopRecord(e) {
        if(dom('msg-input').value.trim().length > 0) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        if(mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
            mediaRecorder.stop();
            micBtn.classList.remove('recording');
        }
    }

    function visualizeAudio() {
        const bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
        const dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);
        const bars = document.querySelectorAll('.vis-bar');

        const animate = () => {
            if(dom('rec-visualizer').classList.contains('hidden')) return;
            analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
            for(let i=0; i<bars.length; i++) {
                const val = dataArray[i * 2]; 
                const h = 5 + (val / 255) * 30;
                bars[i].style.height = `${h}px`;
            }
            visualizerInterval = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        };
        animate();
    }

            await agoraClient.leave();
            if (localAudioTrack) { localAudioTrack.close(); localAudioTrack = null; }
            if (localVideoTrack) { localVideoTrack.close(); localVideoTrack = null; }
        }
        
        const partnerId = currentChat ? currentChat.uid : (incomingCallData ? incomingCallData.caller : null);
        if(partnerId) {
            set(ref(db, `calls/${partnerId}`), { status: 'ended' });
            remove(ref(db, `calls/${currentUser.uid}`));
        }
        resetCallUI();
    };

    function resetCallUI() {
        dom('call-interface').classList.add('hidden');
        dom('incoming-call-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        dom('ringtone').pause();
        dom('ringtone').currentTime = 0;
        dom('local-video-container').innerHTML = '';
        dom('remote-video-container').innerHTML = `<div class="voice-call-ui hidden" id="remote-voice-ui"><img id="remote-voice-pic" src="" class="voice-avatar-large"><h2 id="remote-voice-name">User</h2><p id="call-timer">00:00</p></div>`;
        incomingCallData = null;
        clearInterval(callTimerInterval);
        callDurationSec = 0;
    }

    async function joinAgoraChannel(channelName, type) {
        agoraClient = AgoraRTC.createClient({ mode: "rtc", codec: "vp8" });
        
        agoraClient.on("user-published", async (user, mediaType) => {
            await agoraClient.subscribe(user, mediaType);
            
            if (mediaType === "video") {
                dom('remote-voice-ui').classList.add('hidden'); 
                const remotePlayer = document.createElement('div');
                remotePlayer.id = `user-${user.uid}`;
                remotePlayer.style.width = "100%";
                remotePlayer.style.height = "100%";
                dom('remote-video-container').appendChild(remotePlayer);
                user.videoTrack.play(remotePlayer);
            }
            if (mediaType === "audio") {
                user.audioTrack.play();
            }
        });

        agoraClient.on("user-unpublished", (user) => {
            const player = document.getElementById(`user-${user.uid}`);
            if (player) player.remove();
            if (dom('remote-video-container').children.length <= 1) {
                dom('remote-voice-ui').classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        });

        await agoraClient.join(AGORA_APP_ID, channelName, null, currentUser.uid);

        if (type === 'video') {
            [localAudioTrack, localVideoTrack] = await AgoraRTC.createMicrophoneAndCameraTracks();
            const localPlayer = document.createElement('div');
            localPlayer.style.width = "100%"; localPlayer.style.height = "100%";
            dom('local-video-container').appendChild(localPlayer);
            localVideoTrack.play(localPlayer);
            await agoraClient.publish([localAudioTrack, localVideoTrack]);
            isCamOn = true;
        } else {
            localAudioTrack = await AgoraRTC.createMicrophoneAudioTrack();
            await agoraClient.publish([localAudioTrack]);
            dom('remote-voice-ui').classList.remove('hidden');
            dom('local-video-container').classList.add('hidden');
            isCamOn = false;
        }
        
        isMicOn = true;
        startTimer();
    }

    window.toggleMic = async () => {
        if(!localAudioTrack) return;
        isMicOn = !isMicOn;
        await localAudioTrack.setMuted(!isMicOn);
        dom('btn-mic').className = isMicOn ? "control-btn active" : "control-btn";
        dom('btn-mic').innerHTML = isMicOn ? '<i class="fas fa-microphone"></i>' : '<i class="fas fa-microphone-slash"></i>';
    };

    window.toggleCam = async () => {
        if(!localVideoTrack) return; 
        isCamOn = !isCamOn;
        await localVideoTrack.setMuted(!isCamOn);
        dom('btn-cam').className = isCamOn ? "control-btn active" : "control-btn";
        dom('btn-cam').innerHTML = isCamOn ? '<i class="fas fa-video"></i>' : '<i class="fas fa-video-slash"></i>';
    };

    function startTimer() {
        clearInterval(callTimerInterval);
        callDurationSec = 0;
        callTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
            callDurationSec++;
            const m = Math.floor(callDurationSec / 60);
            const s = callDurationSec % 60;
            dom('call-timer').innerText = `${m}:${s<10?'0'+s:s}`;
        }, 1000);
    }

</script>
